title: M3 module binding registry / M3 模块绑定注册表
description: Registry contract that binds public module roles to concrete callables. A future-active callable must live under M3 src/m3_signal_core; repository-root implementations are allowed only in the separate historical crosswalk. / 把公共模块角色绑定到具体 callable 的注册表合同。未来活动 callable 必须位于 M3 src/m3_signal_core；仓库根目录实现只能出现在独立历史映射表中。

schema_version.description: Exact registry schema version. / 精确注册表 Schema 版本。

registry_id.description: Stable registry identity. / 稳定注册表标识。

status.description: Current status distinguishes available core callables from the still-required profile-locked facade before M4. / 当前状态区分已有核心 callable 与 M4 前仍需实现的配置锁定门面。

future_active_root.description: Only authoritative implementation root for future benchmarks. / 未来 benchmark 唯一权威实现根目录。

m1_input_contract.description: M1 raw signal input authority. / M1 原始信号输入权威。

m1_config_contract.description: M1 pipeline configuration authority. / M1 流水线配置权威。

m1_output_contract.description: M1 inference output authority. / M1 推理输出权威。

m2_dataset_version_id.description: Frozen M2 dataset identity. / 冻结 M2 数据集标识。

m2_fold_registry_id.description: Future corrected subject-level fold authority. / 未来校正受试者级折叠权威。

m2_protocol_id.description: Future OOF evaluation protocol. / 未来 OOF 评估协议。

m3_preprocessing_registry_id.description: Corrected preprocessing profile authority. / 校正预处理配置权威。

m3_physiology_registry_id.description: Corrected physiology algorithm authority. / 校正生理算法权威。

bindings.description: Unique module bindings; binding_id uniqueness is validator-enforced. / 唯一模块绑定；binding_id 唯一性由 validator 强制。

binding_id.description: Stable binding identifier. / 稳定绑定标识。

module_role.description: Public architectural role. / 公共架构角色。

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state; only future_active values may enter a new benchmark. / 生命周期状态；只有 future_active 值可进入新 benchmark。

implementation_path.description: Repository-relative Python implementation path, or null only when not implemented. / 仓库相对 Python 实现路径；仅未实现时可为 null。

callable.description: Importable public callable, or null only when not implemented. / 可导入公共 callable；仅未实现时可为 null。

exported_by.description: Package initializer exporting the public symbol. / 导出公共符号的包初始化文件。

profile_ids.description: Allowed preprocessing profile IDs; empty when profiles do not apply. / 允许的预处理 profile ID；不适用时为空。

algorithm_ids.description: Allowed physiology algorithm IDs; empty when algorithms do not apply. / 允许的生理算法 ID；不适用时为空。

input_contract_ids.description: Accepted machine contract identifiers. / 接受的机器合同标识。

output_contract_ids.description: Emitted machine contract identifiers. / 输出的机器合同标识。

runtime_dependencies.description: Dependencies restricted to the user-approved deployment allowlist. / 依赖仅限用户批准的部署白名单。

future_benchmark_allowed.description: True only for eligible corrected bindings. / 仅符合条件的校正绑定可为 true。

activation_gate.description: Unambiguous remaining gate before use. / 使用前尚需满足的明确门槛。

description_zh.description: Detailed Chinese binding description. / 详细中文绑定说明。

description_en.description: Detailed English binding description. / 详细英文绑定说明。
